{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales.isnull().sum()

# Check column dtypes
dtypes = sales.dtypes

# Check unique values in 'channel' column
unique_channels = sales['channel'].unique()

# Check if 'revenue' column contains only numeric values
revenue_dtype = sales['revenue'].dtype

# Print summary
print("Missing values:", missing_values)
print("\nDtypes:\n", dtypes)
print("\nUnique channels:", unique_channels)
print("\nRevenue column dtype:", revenue_dtype)"}
